show.description: Kartik arrives into the family of Vivan, his sister Shivika and Dadaji, claiming that Kartik’s dad died saving Vivan when he was in a fatal accident with his parents, many years ago. Out of a sense of responsibility Shivika and dadaji decide to adopt Kartik but Vivan soon realises Kartik has ulterior motives. Kartik wants to oust Vivan from his own home and become the undeniable variz of the family.
